name: OCRBench
description: OCRBench: Comprehensive evaluation benchmark for assessing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities in Large Multimodal Models across text recognition, scene text VQA, and document understanding tasks
evaluation_method: accuracy (normalized edit distance for text recognition)
reputation: Widely used OCR benchmark for multimodal models; covers diverse text types including printed, handwritten, and scene text; used in major VLM evaluations including InternVL, Qwen-VL, and Claude reports
notes: Published in 2023, updated in 2024. 1,000 questions across 29 OCR tasks covering text recognition, scene text VQA, KIE (Key Information Extraction), and document understanding. Score is reported as /1000. Covers printed, handwritten, artistic, and scene text. Widely used in Chinese and international VLM evaluation suites.
